lines.zh: 我每走一步，身上掉下细小的东西。
lines.en: Each step sheds something small from my body.

lines.zh: 我不快，但地上一路都有东西在爬。
lines.en: I am not fast, but things crawl in my wake.

lines.zh: 我的腿很长，关节朝后弯。
lines.en: Long legs, joints bending backward.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都枯一块。
lines.en: Grass withers where I pass.

lines.zh: 我挪动的时候，躯干里有东西在挤。
lines.en: When I shift, things crowd inside my torso.
I shuffle toward the lamplight in the house.
I am not one. I am a crowd.

lines.zh: 我的影子在动，比我慢半拍。
lines.en: My shadow moves, half a beat behind me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，很确定。
lines.en: I press in step by step, certain.

lines.zh: 我身上挂着还没长好的东西。
lines.en: Things hang off me, not yet grown.
I stand, and something inside divides.
I open my mouth. Those are not teeth.

lines.zh: 我呼吸的时候，肋骨在动。
lines.en: When I breathe, my ribs move.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是爆发之后长成的。
lines.en: This body grew after the outbreak.
I count how many there are inside me.

lines.zh: 我很安静，因为我一直在听。
lines.en: I am quiet because I am always listening.

lines.zh: 我的皮下面鼓了一下，又平了。
lines.en: Something bulges under my skin, then settles.
I raise a hand; my fingertips tremble.

lines.zh: 我闻到了村子里的味道。
lines.en: I smell the village.
I wait for what is due.
I never need sleep.

lines.zh: 我身上有一处一处在动。
lines.en: Here and there, my body moves.
My bones are soft enough to bend.

lines.zh: 我记得自己不是这个样子。
lines.en: I remember not being like this.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，方向对着光。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the light.

lines.zh: 我下面有东西在爬出去。
lines.en: Something is crawling out from under me.

lines.zh: 你身上有我要的那口热。
lines.en: You carry the warmth I am after.

lines.zh: 这只手抬起来，是为了落下。
lines.en: This hand rises so that it can come down.
Stay still and I will reach you sooner.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下来的东西，会去找你。
lines.en: What drops from me will find you.

lines.zh: 你退得再快，也快不过它。
lines.en: However fast you retreat, it is faster.

lines.zh: 我记得村子里的每一户。
lines.en: I remember every house in the village.
I stopped counting which one you are.

lines.zh: 我的嘴不够用，所以还有别的。
lines.en: My mouth is not enough, so there are others.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一个容器。
lines.en: I look at you like a vessel.
Do not bend to pick that up.
Your breathing sounds good.
I come slowly. No need to hurry.
A piece of me drops away.
That piece will grow back. No hurry.

lines.zh: 被打掉的地方，很快又鼓起来。
lines.en: What was struck swells again.

lines.zh: 嘶声从好几个地方一起出。
lines.en: The hiss comes from several places at once.
That scattered part of me.
I back two steps, shedding.
You know there are many of me.
What fell is still alive.

lines.zh: 我低头看着自己的缺口。
lines.en: I look down at my gap.
You cannot kill all of us.
That ration will never pass my mouth.

lines.zh: 你把食物举给一窝东西。
lines.en: You offer food to a nest of things.
I want something alive. Moving.
That meat is not enough to share.

lines.zh: 你手上那点，还不如你的手。
lines.en: That is worth less than your hand.
Only blood interests me.
Put it down, then walk three steps away.
It is not hunger. It is breeding.
That will not feed all of us.
Keep it. I am waiting for something else.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，有东西掉了。
lines.en: You bumped me, and something dropped.
I did not retreat. I leaned closer.
Do not touch me. It will cling to you.

lines.zh: 这一撞，掉下来的都朝你去了。
lines.en: That knocked loose things toward you.
My body is soft, not hard.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，脚上已经有了。
lines.en: When you stepped back, it was already on your foot.

lines.zh: 撞歪了，身体自己正回来。
lines.en: Knocked askew, the body rights itself.
Things on the ground are looking for you.
You stepped on them.

lines.zh: 再靠近，就是你自己选的。
lines.en: Come closer and it is your own choice.

lines.zh: 我们自己会分出新的一批。
lines.en: We split off new ones on our own.
We divide on our own.
This tier needs no pairing.
The outbreak will bring more.
There are already many of me.
You ask like a human.
Not that talk beside the nest.
I only want the next host.
One body is room enough for all of us.
Get even further off.
I pick up a small carcass.
I push it in, and something inside takes it.
My fingers close and it goes soft.
I keep this to raise.
I pick up an egg.
The egg splits in my palm.
I feed it to what is below.
In my hand it has the wrong weight.
It slips out between my fingers.
There are a few left in my hand.
Still moving means I can still chase.

lines.zh: 你脖子上的热气飘过来。
lines.en: Warmth off your neck drifts over to me.
This distance is right.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，掌心里有东西。
lines.en: I raise my hand; something sits in the palm.
It has taken you as its target.
No use hiding. It is faster.
I stand still and let it go first.
The things inside me begin to crowd.

lines.zh: 你身上有很多地方可以进去。
lines.en: There are many ways into you.
It has landed on the floor.
It is crawling toward you.
I count how long it will take.
Do you hear that sound?
It is at your feet.
Stomping will not help.
My mouth splits into something that is not a smile.

lines.zh: 现在你也是我们的一部分。
lines.en: Now you are part of us too.
It has already come down.
I keep my distance, back there behind you.
It is faster than me. It arrives first.
You changed direction. So did it.
I need not chase. It knows the way.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了两个，还有更多。
lines.en: You crushed two. There are more.
There are more inside me.

lines.zh: 你跑进了屋子，门关上了。
lines.en: You ran inside and shut the door.
That window of yours is open.
I wait until the light inside the door goes out.

lines.zh: 你听得见墙里的声音吗。
lines.en: Do you hear it inside the walls?
No hurry. I can get in.
Your dog has started barking.
It is on the ceiling.
I am above you; you need not look up.

lines.zh: 这个村子，我一个一个来。
lines.en: This village, I take one by one.
There is no gap in that corner for you.
It is right behind you.
I have not moved. It has.
You take a step; I note it.
It is nearly at your feet.

lines.zh: 我一抓，指甲下的东西就进去了。
lines.en: One rake and what is under my nails goes in.
Something enters at my fingertips.
This blow is light, but enough.
I press my hand to you.
I bite once. My teeth are uneven.

lines.zh: 你甩不掉，它已经进去了。
lines.en: You cannot shake it off. It is inside.
One push and you go down.

lines.zh: 我在你身上留下了东西。
lines.en: I have left something on you.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为宿主准备的。
lines.en: This blow is for a host.
Still standing. Then it has time.
I step back and let it grow.

lines.zh: 你抓挠的地方，已经不对了。
lines.en: The place you scratch is already wrong.
I need not strike again.
It has already begun.

lines.zh: 我从一具尸体里撑出来。
lines.en: I push out of a corpse.
My first breath is rot.

lines.zh: 我刚从里面撑出来，还软。
lines.en: I have only just pushed my way out; still soft.

lines.zh: 地上还有很多像我一样的。
lines.en: Many like me are on the ground.
The outbreak timer is still running.
Under a grey sky I first find my bearings.
The first of them drop from me.
They land and start crawling.

lines.zh: 我听见远处村子里有声音。
lines.en: I hear sounds from the village far off.

lines.zh: 我的腿一节一节长出来。
lines.en: My legs grow, joint by joint.

lines.zh: 这具身体，原来是别人的。
lines.en: This body used to belong to somebody.
I remember being hungry a long time.
I walk toward the nearest living thing.
A trail of them follows me.
This tier is the parasitic one.
I am not the last.
I am stronger than the last batch.
I am standing. Very unsteadily.
My chest splits open and closes.
Now it is this world's turn.
Fire makes my body crackle.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，散了一半又聚回来。
lines.en: I fall, half scatter, and gather again.
In water I move more slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀开，碎片都在爬。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; the pieces crawl.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进来，卡在里面。
lines.en: Something lodges in me and stays.

lines.zh: 咒力在我体内烧，我里面的东西乱了。
lines.en: A curse burns inside and my contents scramble.
Not enough hosts. I am shrinking.

lines.zh: 这一道雷，让我散了半秒。
lines.en: That bolt scatters me for half a second.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我散着落下去。
lines.en: No ground below. I fall apart, falling.
